concerns.text: FR-003 mandates a chi‑squared goodness‑of‑fit test against the **uniform** distribution (with exact fallback when expected counts < 5). The current task set (T008, T009, T017) implements the test against a **biased** expected count derived from literature, never against uniform. Consequently the functional requirement FR‑003 is not satisfied by any task.

FR-005 requires visualization artifacts that overlay observed residue frequencies with the **uniform expectation** N/p. Task T010’s visualization suite explicitly plots against the biased theoretical baseline, not the uniform line, leaving FR‑005 uncovered.
